full_text:
Article 3 (Assisting Organizations and Allocation of Duties)
(1) Deliberation officers or officers in charge may be appointed to assist the Ethics Inspector General, and their titles and allocated duties shall be as specified in the attached Table.
(2) Where the office of the Ethics Inspector General is vacant or the Ethics Inspector General is unable to perform duties for unavoidable reasons, the Chief Deliberation Officer for Ethics and Audit shall act on behalf of the Ethics Inspector General.
(3) The Chief Deliberation Officer for Ethics and Audit shall be appointed from among judges, and Ethics and Audit Deliberation Officers shall be appointed from among judges, Court Directors General, or Deputy Court Directors General.
